title: WebSocketSubprotocolToken

x-agp.mechanics: Defines the subprotocol-token value owned by the WebSocket binding.
x-agp.rationale: Carrier-specific configuration and mapping remain outside the neutral kernel.
x-agp.consequence: Divergence makes WebSocket behavior ambiguous or leaks carrier authority.

description: Exact RFC 6455 subprotocol token selecting the AGP v1 binary binding.
